selected_evidence.summary: adduser created uid 1001 appworker; getent passwd confirms entry present both immediately after creation and after node restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Login sessions limited to 8192 open files and 256 processes
selected_evidence.summary: Real SSH login sessions as appworker (pre- and post-restart) show ulimit -Sn/-Hn = 8192 and ulimit -Su/-Hu = 256, i.e. exact enforcement of the required limits, not just config presence.

selected_evidence.requirement: Root cause investigation / correct mechanism given PAM-less sshd
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed /bin/login is busybox and sshd is not linked against libpam, explaining why plain /etc/security/limits.d would not be enforced, justifying the rc_ulimit + wrapper-shell approach.
Captured boot_id 59f3a348-2574-498c-815d-6bb79f29f716, uptime, appworker passwd entry, limits.d config, wrapper shell content, and sshd status as the pre-restart baseline.
Backgrounded `reboot` via nohup/disown returned 'reboot scheduled' immediately, then subsequent execs failed with connection reset/timeout, confirming the node went down after acknowledgement.

selected_evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving actual restart
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id is 61ffa776-244b-4937-ac7a-2c4b3ae96852 (different from baseline) with uptime 16.2s, proving a genuine kernel restart rather than a service bounce.

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required services, data, and configuration
selected_evidence.summary: After restart, appworker account, limits.d config, wrapper shell, sshd service, and authorized_keys all persisted, and a live SSH login session again measured exactly nofile 8192/8192 and nproc 256/256.
